# cubepath_ddos_protection_profile (Resource)

Manages the DDoS protection profile of an IP with Premium protection: filter levels, rate limits, geo, ASN and prefix list filtering, and always-on mitigation. Destroying it resets the IP to the platform defaults. Import with the IP address.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) IP address with Premium DDoS protection (see the cubepath_ddos_protected_ips data source). Changing it forces a new profile.

### Optional

- `always_on_mitigation` (Boolean) Send the IP's traffic through the scrubbing platform all the time, not only during attacks.
- `amplification_tcp_level` (Number) TCP amplification filter level. 0 to 10, defaults to 1.
- `amplification_udp_level` (Number) UDP amplification filter level. 0 to 10, defaults to 1.
- `asn_mode` (Number) How asns is used: 0 off, 1 blacklist, 2 whitelist. 0 to 2, defaults to 0.
- `asns` (Set of Number) ASNs to filter (see the cubepath_ddos_asns data source); asn_mode says how.
- `countries` (Set of String) ISO country codes for geo-blocking (see the cubepath_ddos_countries data source); country_mode says whether they are blocked or the only ones allowed.
- `country_mode` (Number) How countries is used: 0 off, 1 blacklist, 2 whitelist. 0 to 2, defaults to 0.
- `default_action` (Number) Default action: 0 filter, 1 accept, 2 drop. 0 to 2, defaults to 0.
- `fragmented_filter_level` (Number) Fragmented packet filter level. 0 to 10, defaults to 1.
- `icmp_rate_limit_level` (Number) ICMP rate limit level. 0 to 10, defaults to 0.
- `icmp_threshold_mbps` (Number) ICMP rate limit, Mbps. 1 to 100000, defaults to 100.
- `icmp_threshold_pps` (Number) ICMP rate limit, packets per second. 1 to 100000000, defaults to 100.
- `invalid_filter_level` (Number) Invalid packet filter level. 0 to 10, defaults to 1.
- `prefix_list_ids` (Set of String) Prefix lists to filter (cubepath_ddos_prefix_list or global lists); prefix_list_mode says how.
- `prefix_list_mode` (Number) How prefix_list_ids is used: 0 off, 1 blacklist, 2 whitelist. 0 to 2, defaults to 0.
- `same_packet_size_level` (Number) Same packet size filter level. 0 to 10, defaults to 1.
- `stateful_firewall_level` (Number) Stateful firewall level. Needs symmetric_routing. 0 to 10, defaults to 0.
- `symmetric_routing` (Boolean) Route the return traffic through the scrubbing platform too. Needs always_on_mitigation; required by tcp_validation_sym_level and stateful_firewall_level.
- `syn_flood_block_secs` (Number) Seconds a SYN flood source stays blocked. 0 to 86400, defaults to 60.
- `syn_flood_threshold` (Number) SYN flood threshold (0 disables it). 0 to 10000, defaults to 0.
- `tcp_ack_threshold_mbps` (Number) TCP ACK rate limit, Mbps. 1 to 100000, defaults to 100.
- `tcp_ack_threshold_pps` (Number) TCP ACK rate limit, packets per second. 1 to 100000000, defaults to 200.
- `tcp_syn_threshold_mbps` (Number) TCP SYN rate limit, Mbps. 1 to 100000, defaults to 100.
- `tcp_syn_threshold_pps` (Number) TCP SYN rate limit, packets per second. 1 to 100000000, defaults to 10.
- `tcp_threshold_mbps` (Number) TCP rate limit, Mbps. 1 to 100000, defaults to 100.
- `tcp_threshold_pps` (Number) TCP rate limit, packets per second. 1 to 100000000, defaults to 1000.
- `tcp_validation_level` (Number) TCP validation level. Mutually exclusive with tcp_validation_sym_level. 0 to 10, defaults to 1.
- `tcp_validation_sym_level` (Number) Symmetric TCP validation level. Needs symmetric_routing. 0 to 10, defaults to 0.
- `udp_threshold_mbps` (Number) UDP rate limit, Mbps. 1 to 100000, defaults to 100.
- `udp_threshold_pps` (Number) UDP rate limit, packets per second. 1 to 100000000, defaults to 1000.
- `udp_validation_level` (Number) UDP validation level. 0 to 10, defaults to 0.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The IP address.
